title: Connector Identity & Stable IDs

connector_id.stable_when: stable across package versions and installations
connector_id.lifecycle: changes only when the connector identity is intentionally forked

publisher_id.stable_when: stable for the publisher across its connector packages

package_id.stable_when: stable across package versions in one lineage
package_id.lifecycle: changes when a package is forked into a new lineage

installation_id.stable_when: stable until the local installation is removed
installation_id.lifecycle: must not be derived from device or account secrets
installation_id.privacy: local opaque identifier; never a credential

account_id.scope: one provider account within a connector
account_id.stable_when: stable for the provider subject while the account remains linked
account_id.lifecycle: changes when the provider account is unlinked or the subject changes
account_id.privacy: provider-scoped non-PII handle; never raw profile data

connection_id.stable_when: stable for the connection until revoke or replacement
connection_id.source: local state generated once per connection
connection_id.privacy: opaque handle; never a token or secret

claim_boundary: This is a local identity contract, not a live provider certification.
IDs are opaque handles and do not contain credentials, tokens, or secrets.
External publisher verification and provider subject evidence remain deferred.
